sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strongly placed and will be heavy favorites against an Alsager side sitting bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in an intriguing meeting of two strong sides—Bridgnorth currently third with 19 points and a recent loss, while sixth-placed Eccleshall (18 points) sit just behind and are in better recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community (13 points), who then host Brereton Social midweek in a Wednesday night fixture. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) are away at Foley Meir (11 points, struggling) in a match that favors the visitors. Barnton (15 points) visit Shawbury United, who are in free-fall with six consecutive losses and look vulnerable. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half clash, while Crewe host Allscott Heath and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in two lower-division encounters. Widnes Town, pointless and winless, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday and face an uphill battle.
